summary.text: Ryan Malinoski is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 82, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously ran for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Malinoski was the Republican candidate for Michigan House District 82 in 2022, when Democrat Kristian Grant defeated him and Green candidate Gerard Akkerhuis, with Malinoski receiving 24.5% of the vote.
In 2024 he again lost the general election for the seat to incumbent Grant.
